_note: World Event deck. effect.type is read by the engine. Visa denied no longer sends to jail (jail was removed); it now sends you back to the nearest airport behind you.

worldEvents.name: Local lottery
worldEvents.text: You won the local lottery. Collect $100.

worldEvents.name: Property value surge
worldEvents.text: Collect $10 for every property you own.

worldEvents.name: Car crash
worldEvents.text: Pay $100 medical bills and miss your next turn.

worldEvents.name: Flight delayed
worldEvents.text: Your next airport fee collection is skipped.

worldEvents.name: Natural disaster
worldEvents.text: Pay $50 for each city you own in this section.

worldEvents.name: Visa denied
worldEvents.text: Go back to the nearest airport behind you.

worldEvents.name: Rerouted
worldEvents.text: Advance to the nearest airport. If owned, pay double the landing fee.

worldEvents.name: Advance to New Year
worldEvents.text: Advance to New Year and collect salary on the way.

worldEvents.name: House swap
worldEvents.text: Swap places with a random other player.
